name: Team Graph - multi-hop entailment
description: 'Depends On' is transitive. A 2-edge chain (team-a -> team-b -> team-c) passes the endpoint matrix and is consistent, but the reasoner ENTAILS the non-asserted edge team-a Depends On team-c. This demonstrates multi-hop reasoning (completeness / implied knowledge) that the constraint layer alone cannot produce.

relationships.name: Team A depends on Team B
Team B depends on Team C
